title: Nanostructured UiO-66 Gel for Efficient PFAS Remediation: Electron Microscopy Insights
content: The increasing prevalence of per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS), the so called “forever chemicals”, in water sources demands new innovative and effective remediation approaches and strategies. PFAS, including perfluorooctanoic acid (PFOA), pose a significant threat to the environment and our health due to their persistence and toxicity [1,2].
